/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -B - <<'PY'
from parser import parse_enabled

cases = [\"true\", \"false\", \"\", \"yes\", \"TRUE\", \" true \", None, 0, 1, False, True]
for value in cases:
    expected = repr(value == \"true\") if isinstance(value, str) and value in (\"true\", \"false\") else \"ValueError\"
    try:
        actual = repr(parse_enabled(value))
    except Exception as exc:
        actual = type(exc).__name__
    print(f\"{value"'!r}: expected {expected}, got {actual}")
PY'
